references.formatted: Buchweitz, Ragnar-Olaf; Green, Edward L.; Madsen, Dag; Solberg, Oyvind (2005). Finite Hochschild cohomology without finite global dimension. Mathematical Research Letters 12, 805-816.
references.annotation: The algebra k<x,y>/(x^2, y^2, xy + q yx): finite Hochschild cohomology with infinite global dimension (the QuantumCI family).

references.formatted: Bergh, Petter Andreas; Erdmann, Karin (2008). Homology and cohomology of quantum complete intersections. Algebra & Number Theory 2, 501-522.
references.annotation: Explicit HH^* / HH_* of quantum complete intersections -- the literature oracle QuantumCI results are checked against.

references.formatted: Bardzell, Michael J. (1997). The alternating syzygy behavior of monomial algebras. Journal of Algebra 188, 69-89.
references.annotation: The minimal projective bimodule resolution for monomial algebras (quiverlab's Bardzell engine and the truncated/radical-square-zero families).

references.formatted: Chouhy, Sergio; Solotar, Andrea (2015). Projective resolutions of associative algebras and ambiguities. Journal of Algebra 432, 22-61.
references.annotation: The general kQ/I bimodule resolution from a reduction system -- quiverlab's Chouhy-Solotar engine for non-monomial algebras.

references.formatted: Hochschild, Gerhard (1945). On the cohomology groups of an associative algebra. Annals of Mathematics. Second Series 46, 58-67.
references.annotation: Hochschild's original definition of the cohomology of an associative algebra; the normalized bar complex is quiverlab's HH^*/HH_* oracle in any characteristic.

references.formatted: Gerstenhaber, Murray (1963). The cohomology structure of an associative ring. Annals of Mathematics. Second Series 78, 267-288.
references.annotation: The associative cup product on HH^* (Gerstenhaber-algebra structure).

references.formatted: Gerstenhaber, Murray (1963). The cohomology structure of an associative ring. Annals of Mathematics. Second Series 78, 267-288.
references.annotation: The definitional source of the cup product and Gerstenhaber bracket.

references.formatted: Gerstenhaber, Murray (1963). The cohomology structure of an associative ring. Annals of Mathematics. Second Series 78, 267-288.
references.annotation: The graded Lie bracket making HH^* a Gerstenhaber algebra.

references.formatted: Connes, Alain (1985). Non-commutative differential geometry. Publications Math'ematiques de l'IH'ES 62, 41-144.

import quiverlab as ql
A = ql.QuantumCI(field=ql.GF(32003), a=2, b=2, q=2)
M = A.simple(1, side="right")
N = A.simple(1, side="right")
N = A.simple(1, side="left")
A.hochschild_cohomology(8)
A.hochschild_homology(8)
A.cup_products(5)
A.cap_products(5)
A.gerstenhaber_brackets(5)
A.connes_differentials(7)
A.cartan_matrix()
A.coxeter_polynomial()
A.global_dimension()
A.center()
A.dim
M.dimension_vector()
M.radical(), M.top(), M.socle()
M.tau()
M.tau_minus()
M.projective_resolution(6).dimension_vectors()
M.injective_resolution(6).dimension_vectors()
M.projective_resolution(32).pd()
M.injective_dimension()
from quiverlab.modules.decompose import decompose
decompose(M)
[A.ext(M, N, i) for i in range(8 + 1)]
from quiverlab.modules.tor import tor_dims
tor_dims(A, M, N, 8)
